The '''Toli-X vaccine''' was created against the [[Toli-X]] [[virus]] shortly after the virus appeared around [[54 BBY/Legends|54 BBY]] and contaminated many [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. Though lethal to [[Human/Legends|Humans]] if untreated, the Toli-X infection could be cured by the vaccine.
